thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'orchid-dedicated-3' node gpu-5 is reporting repeated PSU undervoltage events and ECC spikes. Auto-evac recommended. Severity: P1. Affected tenants: small number of active LumosHealth jobs on gpu-5. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/pools/orchid-dedicated-3

pager-oncall: paging xander + mira — oncall, can you pick this up? :rotating_light:

xander: I’m on it. seeing repeated `AER`/`SMI` in logs and node lost NVLINK a few times. Starting cordon/drain for node gpu-5.

mira: grabbing runbook. quick ask — do we isolate entire machine or just GPU? last time PSU issues caused host OOB reset.

xander: thinking isolate host. plan: 1) drain pods on gpu-5 (prefer tenant-aware eviction), 2) prevent new allocations, 3) route affected LumosHealth traffic to backup pool orchid-dedicated-1, 4) kick hardware replacement ticket.

eng_lead_ops: +1. keep tenant isolation — LumosHealth is on a dedicated VPC slice, don't shift other tenants. notify solutions and support so they're prepped to contact customer if we need a brief outage.

platform_sre: runbook snippet:
```
# cordon and drain node (tenant-aware)
rci node cordon --pool orchid-dedicated-3 --node gpu-5
rci drain-node --pool orchid-dedicated-3 --node gpu-5 --filter-tenant "lumos-prod" --grace 120
# trigger cache eviction and kv persist
rci cache flush --node gpu-5 --tenant "lumos-prod"
```
Note: use `--filter-tenant` to avoid moving other tenants' workloads.

xander: starting drain now. issuing commands.

support_ivy: pinging LumosHealth CS lead (internal ticket created #INC-72468) — we should tell them estimated impact: up to 90s for running jobs, some queued jobs might be rescheduled to backup pool causing slight latency.

solutions_jay: FYI, the backup pool has quantized model variants for cost; check compatibility for LumosHealth model v2. If inference quality differs, we should enable automatic fallback to hosted model temporarily.

mira: logs excerpt from gpu-5 around the last reset:
```
[2026-03-04T12:03:11Z] ECC correctable errors rising: 124 -> 432 in 15m
[2026-03-04T12:03:19Z] PSU undervoltage event: VGPU rail dip -3.2% threshold
[2026-03-04T12:03:22Z] NVLINK reset detected
[2026-03-04T12:03:25Z] kernel: gpu-5: watchdog reset
```
Looks like power sag causing memory errors then link resets.

platform_sre: while drain proceeds, set host to maintenance in the orchestration layer so autoscaler doesn't redeploy there: `orchctl host set-maintenance host-523 --reason "PSU sag"`

xander: drain finished for LumosHealth tenant activities. Verified KV cache persisted and rehydration on backup pool successful for 98% of keys. A few long-running jobs were retried and completed on orchid-dedicated-1.

support_ivy: updated LumosHealth ticket: "We've isolated affected node and shifted running jobs to backup pool. You may see brief retries; no data loss observed. Replacement scheduled, ETA hardware swap 4h."

eng_lead_ops: opened hardware ticket to facilities and cloud provider: HWTCK-98823 — request PSU module replacement and host health check (thermal + BMC). Also flagged potential preemption risk: host is on a spot-backed instance class — we've requested migration to non-preemptible host for replacement.

mira: one follow-up: while cluster drain in progress we observed a correlated spot termination event on host-523 ~30s after PSU dip. Could be provider-level power/placement flapping. Recommend moving LumosHealth back to reserved pool or set policy to avoid spot in their SLA.

solutions_jay: noted — will prepare a follow-up with account team proposing reserved capacity for LumosHealth; include cost delta and SLA improvement.

platform_sre: monitoring for error recurrence. setting alert threshold lower for nvlink resets on orchid pools for next 48h.

xander: handing off to platform_sre for overnight watch. Summary for next oncall: node gpu-5 isolated, host in maintenance, LumosHealth workloads moved to orchid-dedicated-1, hardware ticket open, monitor for repeat undervoltage events or spot preemptions.

pager-oncall: @platform_sre — you're oncall owner for the handoff window. Please ack and post status in 1h. :thumbsup:

platform_sre: ack — will watch and escalate if we see >3 undervoltage events in 1h. Also scheduling a follow-up post-mortem with ops and solutions.

support_ivy: closing note to customer: "We'll follow up with a timeline after hardware replacement. We don't expect recurring user-visible issues; if you see anything, please escalate to your CSM."

mira: post-mortem TODOs assigned: hardware RFO, evaluate spot exposure for dedicated pools, improve tenant-aware drain test coverage, add automated fallback check in rollout for model compatibility.

xander: thanks team. tagging reaction :white_check_mark: — handing off."
